title: ITIL with DevOps and PRINCE2
group: Value streams, AI and other frameworks (10%)

header.html: Understand how ITIL collaborates with DevOps practices and how the two are complementary in the product and service development lifecycle; understand why project management is important in ITIL and how ITIL and PRINCE2 are complementary
the official ITIL Foundation (Version 5) syllabus, version 5.0 (February 2026), category 7

html:
1ITIL and DevOps

DevOps is a culture and set of practices that joins development and operations to deliver software faster and more reliably, with collaboration, automation, continuous integration and delivery, and fast feedback.

ITIL and DevOps How they fit
Shared aims Both aim at value, collaboration, feedback and improvement
DevOps brings Fast delivery, automation, continuous integration and delivery, a culture of shared ownership
ITIL brings Governance, a whole-lifecycle view, service quality and support, practices such as incident, problem and change
Together Teams move fast and stay in control; operate and support feed learning back into discover, design and build

Exam tip

. Complementary, not competing. DevOps adds speed and automation; ITIL adds governance and the full lifecycle view.

2ITIL and PRINCE2

PRINCE2 is a project management method. Many changes and new products are delivered as projects, so project management matters inside ITIL.

ITIL and PRINCE2 How they fit
ITIL gives The lifecycle, practices, value focus for running products and services
PRINCE2 gives A structured way to plan, control and deliver a project (business case, stages, controls, roles)
Together Projects deliver the new or changed product; ITIL operates and improves it afterwards

Why project management matters in ITIL: it provides planning, resources, risk and progress control when building or changing products and services, and hands over to operate, deliver and support.

Exam tip

. PRINCE2 = projects. ITIL = the life of products and services. Complementary.

Exam tip

. Only one mark covers other frameworks. The safe answer is almost always complementary: DevOps adds speed and automation, PRINCE2 adds project control, ITIL adds the lifecycle and governance.

3Exam Q&A

3.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which statement best describes the relationship between ITIL and DevOps?

  • AThey are complementary: DevOps adds speed and automation, ITIL adds governance and a lifecycle view
  • BThey compete, and an organization must choose one
  • CDevOps replaces the ITIL guiding principles
  • DITIL has no use in software delivery
Show the answer

Answer: A. The two complement each other.

S2A company uses PRINCE2 to deliver a new customer app, then runs it using ITIL practices. What does this show?

  • APRINCE2 replaces the lifecycle
  • BITIL replaces project management
  • CITIL and PRINCE2 are complementary
  • DProjects are never needed in ITIL
Show the answer

Answer: C. Projects deliver; ITIL operates and improves.

S3Which statements are CORRECT? (1) PRINCE2 is a project management method. (2) DevOps emphasizes collaboration and automation. (3) ITIL cannot be used with agile teams. (4) PRINCE2 is a replacement for the ITIL value chain.

  • A3 and 4
  • B2 and 3
  • C1 and 4
  • D1 and 2
Show the answer

Answer: D. Those two statements are correct.

S4Identify the missing word(s). ITIL and DevOps are [ ? ] in the product and service development lifecycle.

  • AContradictory
  • BUnrelated
  • CIdentical
  • DComplementary
Show the answer

Answer: D. They complement each other.

S5Why is project management important in ITIL?

  • AIt removes the need for operate and support
  • BIt provides planning and control when building or changing products and services
  • CIt replaces governance
  • DIt defines service levels
Show the answer

Answer: B. Projects deliver changes in a controlled way.

S6Which DevOps practice supports faster releases?

  • AWritten sign-off for every line of code
  • BSeparating development and operations completely
  • CContinuous integration and delivery
  • DDeleting feedback loops
Show the answer

Answer: C. Continuous integration and delivery speed up releases.

3.2 Recall questions

R1What does DevOps combine?

Show the answer

Development and operations, with collaboration and automation.

R2What is PRINCE2?

Show the answer

A project management method.

R3Are ITIL and DevOps competing or complementary?

Show the answer

Complementary.

R4What does ITIL add to a DevOps team?

Show the answer

Governance, a whole-lifecycle view and service quality and support practices.

R5Why does ITIL value project management?

Show the answer

Projects deliver new or changed products and services in a planned, controlled way.

R6What happens after a project delivers a product?

Show the answer

It is operated, delivered and supported, and improved, using ITIL.

4Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
DevOps development plus operations; speed and automation
PRINCE2 project management method
With ITIL complementary, not competing
ITIL adds governance, lifecycle view, practices
